Upper abdominal discomfort with bloating in a young adult male can reflect functional indigestion, especially if symptoms are meal-related and without alarm features.
Bloating with abdominal discomfort is a classic presentation of IBS, which can flare acutely despite being a chronic functional bowel disorder.
